subject: Important Update: Company Meeting Schedule
body: Dear Team, I hope this email finds you well. I would like to inform you of a change in our company meeting schedule. The weekly team meeting will now be held on Thursdays at 10:00 AM instead of Wednesdays. Please mark your calendars accordingly and make sure to attend the upcoming meeting. Your presence and participation are crucial to the success of our projects. Thank you for your attention and cooperation. Best regards, [Your Name]
